# GATEWAY

> Every page of the GATEWAY module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Gateway session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-33/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway): Every ABDM call carries a bearer token from one endpoint. This is that endpoint, plus the certificate and bridge registration calls that sit beside it.
- [Fetch the service ids registered against a bridge](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-33/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-abdm-gateway/01-gateway-get-gateway-v3-bridge-services): Retrieve the unique identifiers, known as service IDs, that are associated with a specific bridge. In this context, a bridge acts as an intermediary...
- [Fetch the details of a service ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-33/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-abdm-gateway/02-gateway-get-gateway-v3-bridge-service-serviceid-service-id): Retrieve the details associated with a specific service ID. When invoked, it queries the system to fetch comprehensive information about the service...
- [Update the bridge URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-33/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-abdm-gateway/03-gateway-patch-gateway-v3-bridge-url): Update the URL of a bridge. When invoked, it allows users to modify the existing URL associated with a specific bridge. This functionality is crucial for...
- [Generate access token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-33/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-abdm-sessions/01-gateway-post-gateway-v3-sessions): Generate an access token. When invoked, it facilitates the authentication process by providing a secure token that can be used to access various services...
